	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = {
					has_focus_tree = LPR
				}
				has_completed_focus = LPR_people_worthy_of_freedom
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { es_fq_result = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { es_fq_can_372 = yes }
		load_oob = es_focus_queue/372
		set_temp_variable = { es_fq_result = 1 }
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = {
					has_focus_tree = RUS_operational_tactical
				}
				has_completed_focus = RUS_Military_assistance_to_the_Peoples_Republics
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { es_fq_result = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { es_fq_can_830 = yes }
		load_oob = es_focus_queue/830
		set_temp_variable = { es_fq_result = 1 }
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = {
					has_focus_tree = National_focuses_of_Ukraine
				}
				has_completed_focus = UKR_emergency_air_defense_requests
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { es_fq_result = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { es_fq_can_1194 = yes }
		load_oob = es_focus_queue/1194
		set_temp_variable = { es_fq_result = 1 }
	}
}
